diagnostic: GCC 14 -Warray-bounds reports memcpy forming offset 1 outside [0,1] when copying a one-byte std::vector in PdfLZWFilter::InitTable
root_cause: GCC 14 optimization/range analysis misdiagnoses a standard vector copy. The initializer clears the byte vector and appends exactly one byte before copying it; each table entry therefore has exactly one byte. A standalone copy of this standard-library-only sequence reproduces the same diagnostic without Qore or PoDoFo. GCC 16 compiles it with the same optimization and warning options without diagnostics.

controls.validated: 257 entries per iteration: 256 one-byte entries matching the byte value, plus one empty sentinel

scope: Only this warning from the unmodified bundled PoDoFo LZW initializer on GCC 14; all compiler checks remain enabled. No source rewrite or warning suppression.
